programme.title: Disaster DIY

programme.title: Disaster DIY

programme.title: Disaster DIY
programme.desc: And the award for 'Most Procrastinated Renovation' goes to Scot's movie theatre that has been in progress for 10 years. Scot promised his wife Alina a cool game and movie theatre area when their first son was a toddler.

programme.title: Disaster DIY
programme.desc: There's a thin line between perfectionist and professional procrastinator and Joe claims to be the former, but is actually the latter. His wife Sharyn is tired of her husband's perfectionist excuse.

programme.title: Disaster DIY
programme.desc: Kim has put up with the family's beastly backyard ever since the family moved in five years ago. Her husband Dave, a comic artist who is used to being the teacher, has everything to learn about renovations.

programme.title: Disaster DIY
programme.desc: Donald's mother is tired of hosting holiday functions because her son's kitchen has been mid-renovation for the last few years. Despite being an expert landscape artist, Donald's skills in the kitchen are novice at best.

programme.title: Disaster DIY
programme.desc: Not only has Jeff lost his kitchen, he's close to losing his sanity. His wife Paula has taken it upon herself to pioneer the kitchen renovations in her house and has her own wacky ideas of how to do so.

programme.title: Disaster DIY
programme.desc: Blame stubbornness, lack of know-how, or both, but Ms. Gabriel's backyard has taken a backseat in upkeep over the last few years. Her idea of fixing the fence is using coat hangers to keep fence boards from falling down.

programme.title: Disaster DIY
programme.desc: Danielle is accusing her jail guard father Andrew of attempted renovation! The crime? One bathroom shared among seven grown adults. Bryan has arrived to get this arrested renovation going and Andrew has no escape.

programme.title: Income Property
programme.desc: Henri and Lori need to renovate their outdated income suite fast so that they can maintain the income they’ve relied on to help offset their heavy business taxes.

programme.title: Income Property
programme.desc: Courtney and Emily need to get their unfinished basement renovated to a high standard apartment ASAP to be able to afford the extra $100,000 mortgage they took on to buy the home.

programme.title: Income Property
programme.desc: Bonnie and Merv have credit card debt in addition to a big mortgage. They need Scott’s help to complete their basement income suite so that they can get out of debt and down the aisle before the end of the year.

programme.title: Income Property
programme.desc: Laura and Peter need to convert the existing professional office space in the basement into a stunning apartment suitable for their cool neighbourhood.

programme.title: Income Property
programme.desc: Antoinette and Mike need a safe income suite tout de suite because Antoinette is expecting and they need the extra income.

programme.title: Income Property
programme.desc: During 18 months of unemployment, Crystal came to depend on her improvised, second floor apartment to avoid defaulting on her mortgage while racking up major debts to keep the house running.

programme.title: Income Property
programme.desc: Rushad wants to move out of his parents’ house and into the triplex he bought last fall. Unfortunately unless he can get the main floor/basement suite renovated and rented, that’s never going to happen.

programme.title: Income Property
programme.desc: Andrea and Luke have a five-year financial plan based on the second floor apartment being consistently rented.

programme.title: Income Property
programme.desc: Tracey fell in love with her home the first day she saw it. But she has since done more destruction than construction and has lost the passion she once felt for her home.

programme.title: Income Property
programme.desc: Divorced dad Kerry needs Scott’s help to finish the basement apartment so that he can collect rental income to give his children the life they deserve.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: The team visit Thirlestane Castle in the Scottish Borders, where treasures include an Art Nouveau claret jug, a full-size leather tiger and an ice-axe signed by famous mountaineers.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: The team returns to Beaumaris Castle, Anglesey, where finds include trophies from the Isle of Man TT race.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow

programme.desc: It's a snowy day, and Kai-lan and her friends are building a snowcoaster that they can all ride! Everyone has a job to do, but Rintoo keeps taking little Hoho's jobs because he can do them so easily.
